title: Elixir of Arcane Cultivation
summary: Gain one level 1 spell slot until Long Rest. Warlocks can use it instead of a Pact Magic slot.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain one level 1 spell slot until Long Rest. Warlocks can use it instead of a Pact Magic slot.
fields.Stacking: Replaces other normal elixirs and can be overwritten by another.
fields.Crafting: Combine Vitriol of Weavemoss with any Sublimate.
fields.Expiry: Losing the condition removes a level 1 slot, prioritizing an already expended slot.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
